content: @kingstinct/react-native-healthkit ~8.2.0 (last updated May 2026). Expo config plugin included — add to app.json plugins array. Does NOT work in Expo Go; requires dev build or EAS build with HealthKit capability. Full TypeScript coverage for all HealthKit data types. This is the only viable HealthKit library for Expo; there is no official Expo HealthKit module.
